With s=sqrt(N^2+4(m-2)(N-1)), the source square coefficients obey c_e^2-N*c_e=(m-2)(N-1), c_o^2+(N-2)*c_o=(m-1)(N-1), 2*c_e-N+2=N+2*c_o=s+2. Even order: A+b^2 B-b(s+2)C = ||Delta v+b x.grad v+b c_e v||_2^2 + b^2 integral(|x|^2|grad v|^2-(x.grad v)^2); equality with b=sqrt(A/B) forces the square and angular defect to vanish, hence smooth radial v. Odd order: A+b^2 B-b(s+2)C=||grad Delta v+b x Delta v+b c_o grad v||_2^2, forcing the vector equation. Set w=Delta v+b c_o v; grad w=-b x Delta v makes w radial, then Delta v and (since c_o>0) v radial. Even radial ODE v"+((N-1)/r+b*r)v"prime+b*c_e*v=0; odd write y=v"prime/r, obtaining y"+((N+1)/r+b*r)y"prime+b(N+c_o)y=0. Smooth radial initial-value uniqueness at r=0 makes each regular solution space one-dimensional; Kummer functions give exactly the two claimed hypergeometric P_(m-2) profiles with parameters (N-s)/4 and (N+2-s)/4. Independently rederived the full weighted-tensor Fourier energy identity and checked the c_e,c_o and hypergeometric parameter algebra exactly with SymPy, plus four independent ODE residual samples (N,m)=(2,3),(3,4),(4,5),(5,8), numerically negligible, not a substitute for the all-parameter proof. The graph-domain hypothesis justifies source cutoff extension; no claim of classification for arbitrary abstract seminorm-completion elements or u modulo nullspace is made.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Let k=m-1, f=Fourier(u), and g(xi)=|xi|^k f(xi). The full tensor Frobenius norm and Plancherel give A=int |xi|^2|g|^2, C=int |g|^2, and B=int(|grad g|^2+k(N-1)|xi|^{-2}|g|^2). Set gamma=(2-N+sqrt(N^2+4(m-2)(N-1)))/2>0, so gamma(gamma+N-2)=k(N-1). The standard inverse-square ground-state transform h=|xi|^{-gamma}g and integration by parts yield B=int |xi|^{2gamma}|grad h|^2, A=int |xi|^{2gamma+2}|h|^2, C=int |xi|^{2gamma}|h|^2, initially on the smooth punctured core and then in the square/weighted completion by density. These are exactly the L2 Caffarelli-Kohn-Nirenberg functionals with (a,b)=(-gamma-1,-gamma). The pair lies in the original 2021 A1 region because b+1-a=2>0 and b=-gamma<=(N-2)/2 for N>=2. Cazacu-Flynn-Lam Theorem 1.1 (and 2026 Do-Lam-Lu-Nguyen Theorem A) gives the sharp constant (N-(a+b+1))/2=(N+2gamma)/2=(2+sqrt(N^2+4(m-2)(N-1)))/2 and ALL equality profiles h=D exp(-lambda|xi|^2/2), D nonzero, lambda>0. Thus g=D|xi|^gamma exp(-lambda|xi|^2/2) is necessarily radial and unique up to complex/real scalar and dilation. Hu-Liu-Zou already give the inverse-Fourier Kummer profiles; Kummer transformation matches even (1-gamma)/2=(N-s)/4 and odd (2-gamma)/2=(N+2-s)/4, with spatial b=1/lambda. Therefore both existence AND exhaustion of the assigned profiles are implied by published general weighted CKN optimizer classification, even though the focal paper states only existence.

Here the actual asserted set is fully determined by the existing 2009/2021 free-parameter weighted CKN optimizer classification after a direct Fourier/tensor norm calculation and inverse-square ground-state substitution, while the precise spatial hypergeometric profiles were already constructed in the focal 2026 source. The proposed work neither identifies a new independent invariant nor proves stability, an unaddressed parameter regime, a new spectral estimate, or a classification outside the known CKN optimizer family. Thus the claimed contribution is a mechanically implied special case of a stronger existing theorem; this value judgment is separate from correctness and not based on paper size or inaccessible literature.
